_doc: fpf_trimul_v4 launch cells keyed '<cc major.minor>|<triton major.minor>' (programme hazard #26: never key by cc alone). k1 = LN_in + dual gated projection (_k1c pointer loads; _k1t device TMA descriptors when impl='tma'; kdesc._k1d host descriptors with transposed incoming planes when impl='tma2'); k3 = _k3c epilogue (kdesc._k3d host descriptors when impl='tma'); the descriptor cells serve plane extents >= kdesc.N_MIN_DESC on bf16 input, else the replaced kernels of the same numbers. Lookup order: exact 'cc|triton' -> 'cc|*' (pointer-load cell valid for any triton >= 3.3 on that cc; printed as generic) -> no row -> STOCK forward. status CERTIFIED_OP rows name their op-level evidence jobs (numerics vs stock+fp64 on real dumps, r2r, graph replay); other statuses are served only with FPF_TRIMUL_V4_ALLOW_DEFAULT_CELLS=1.
